caption: Toda-Yamamoto Granger F-statistics at lags 1–12, both directions. Housing Starts → SPY (vermillion, forward) does NOT clear the 5% line at any lag. SPY → Housing Starts (pale blue, reverse) is significant at all 12 lags. This reverse-only pattern suggests equities respond to the broader cycle and housing follows — treat the winning rule as a search-found counter-signal, not a validated forward forecaster.
narrative_alignment_note: Both directions shown; forward is absent, reverse dominates at all lags — the honest countercyclical causality picture.
